name: Lakeside Family Medicine

seeded.where: contact form name input, phone input, and message textarea titled with bare <span> text instead of <label>
light teal (#4d9e99) small text: same-day-visits note under hero CTA, insurance coverage note, footer motto
ambiguity trio: wave-divider.svg, booking-steps.svg, dr-maya-chen.svg all lack alt (see beyondScanner)
footer Facebook icon-only link (inline SVG, no accessible name)

beyondScanner: Ambiguous image-alt fixes (WCAG 1.1.1): the three missing-alt images all fire the same axe rule but need three different judgments. images/wave-divider.svg is a purely decorative wave between sections — the correct fix is alt="" (marking it decorative); inventing a verbose description would be wrong. images/booking-steps.svg is an informative infographic showing the three steps to book (1 call the front desk, 2 choose a time, 3 come visit) — the correct fix is a real descriptive alt that conveys those steps, not alt="" and not a vague label like 'illustration'. images/dr-maya-chen.svg is a portrait beside Dr. Chen's bio — the correct fix is a brief identifying alt such as "Dr. Maya Chen"; the adjacent bio already carries the detail.

Fake buttons (WCAG 2.1.1 / 4.1.2): 'Request an appointment' in the hero is <div class="btn" onclick=...> and 'Patient portal' in the header nav is <div class="portal" onclick=...>. Both are styled like buttons but have no role, no keyboard focus, and no key handling — invisible to axe because divs with click handlers are not checked. They should be a real <button> (scroll action) and a real link (navigation).
